short.en: Every piece must be a word

t.zh: 一串字母没有空格，比如 catsanddog。把它切成词典里的词，最少切成几块？
t.en: A string of letters with no spaces, such as catsanddog. Cut it into dictionary words: how few pieces will do?

t.zh: 格子 i 记：前 i 个字母最少切成几块。第 0 格是开头，一个字母都没有，0 块。
t.en: Cell i records: the fewest pieces the first i letters can be cut into. Cell 0 is the start, with no letters at all: 0 pieces.

t.zh: 只看最后一块：它从前面某个切点开始，到这里结束。扫描臂扫过前面每个切点，一次送来两段：切点那里的格子，和从那里到这里那一块的代价。这一关，那一块是词就算 1，不是词就是「—」。
t.en: Look only at the last piece: it starts at some earlier cut and ends here. The sweep arm sweeps every earlier cut and brings two runs at once: the cell at each cut, and what the piece from there to here costs. In this level a piece that is a word costs 1, and one that isn’t is “—”.

goal.zh: 算出每串字母最少切成几块词典里的词。
goal.en: Work out the fewest dictionary words each string can be cut into.

how.en: The dictionary is shown next to the tests.

say.zh: 扫描臂的第二段是每一块的代价：不是词的那一块是「—」，加法器会把它跳过。
say.en: The arm’s second run is each piece’s cost: a piece that isn’t a word is “—”, and the Adder drops it.

hints.zh: 每个切点：那里最少几块 + 这一块。加法器会把两段一项一项相加。
hints.en: At every cut: the fewest pieces up to there + this piece. An Adder adds two runs up item by item.

hints.zh: 在所有切点里取较小。开头是 0 块：「是开头」放过一个 0。
hints.en: Take the smallest over all the cuts. The start is 0 pieces: let a 0 through with “is start”.

body.zh: 搜索引擎遇到 bestbuy、输入法遇到一串没打空格的拼音，都要先切词。
body.en: A search engine that meets bestbuy, or a Chinese input method given a run of pinyin with no spaces, has to break it into words first.

body.zh: 每个切点都试一遍，取最省的那个：来路的数量随数据变化，表照样能填。
body.en: Try every cut and keep the cheapest: the number of ways in changes with the data, and the table fills all the same.
